q: Tell me about a time you shipped something quickly and it went wrong. What did you own?
point: 快不是问题，静默失败才是；我加了"响亮失败"的守卫

q: Give an example of stepping into a problem that wasn't yours.
point: 没人分配，但每个人都被它拖慢

q: Tell me about a time you were wrong and changed your mind publicly.
principle: **I**ntellectual honesty（"facts over ego … disagree, commit, move forward"）
point: 用数据推翻自己的估算并主动更正

q: Tell me about a disagreement where you committed to a decision you didn't agree with.
point: 讲清我的主张、最后的决定、我如何全力执行

q: How do you make sure what you build is actually useful to the customer?
principle: **C**ustomer obsession（"never do work that holds no customer value"）
point: 先问谁会看这个输出、误报的代价是谁付

q: What's a bar you raised on your team?
story: [[S2]] 质量门禁 · [[S1]] 校验 UDTF
point: 把"对不对"变成自动门禁

q: How do you work when there's no process for what you need to do?
principle: O-11 "rigid rules … the open-endedness" · O-13 "When the path isn't clear, you're expected to make one"
point: 先写下已知/未知，提出方案，设可回滚点，推进

q: How has AI changed the way you work in the last six months?
principle: O-12 "rethink your work around what AI makes possible"
point: 不是更快写同样的代码，而是做以前不值得做的事（clone 池、on-call copilot）

q: How do you give and receive feedback?
principle: Excellence（"raise the bar in our work, our feedback"）

q: What would make you leave a job?
point: 不能 own 结果、离用户太远（真诚，短）
